name: Employee & Badge Profiling
description: Understanding how employees look, dress, move, and behave at a target is essential for convincing impersonation and tailgating. This includes identifying badge designs (color, logo placement, clip type, lanyard color), uniform styles for different roles, and how security personnel interact with visitors. LinkedIn and social media often reveal employee photos with visible badges or uniforms. Long-range photography during perimeter surveying supplements this with real-time behavioral data.

blue.det: Individual observing employee entry/exit patterns; photographing badge designs or access hardware; loitering near entry points during shift changes.
blue.cm: Camera coverage of all entry points; employee awareness training on credential exposure; challenge anyone photographing staff or access hardware; anti-skimming badge sleeves.
